title: 340 MB of Playwright screenshot baselines are committed to git, 29 of them byte-identical copies, and are most of the 628 MB .git.

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: test/e2e/__screenshots__/visual.spec.ts/ holds 154 tracked PNGs, ~347 MB (git ls-files | du). 29 files share an md5 with another (e.g. about--dawn-light-desktop.png == about--midnight-light-desktop.png, both 798d6638...). .gitattributes has no LFS rule; .git is 628M.

WHY IT MATTERS: Every clone, CI checkout and cloud agent session pulls ~0.6 GB. Slower clones and CI; baselines churn adds to history forever.

FIX DIRECTION: Move baselines to Git LFS or an artifact store, and de-duplicate identical dawn/midnight captures (or skip the redundant variant).

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
